Package de.labathome.trustconstr.sparse

Class CSCMatrix

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.sparse.CSCMatrix
public final class CSCMatrix extends Object
Compressed Sparse Column matrix. Storage analogue of scipy.sparse.csc_array. Layout mirrors CSRMatrix with rows and columns swapped: 
 indptr.length == cols + 1
 indptr[j] .. indptr[j+1] is the half-open range of indices/data
     entries belonging to column j.
 indices[k] is the row of the k-th stored entry (0 ≤ indices[k] < rows).
 data[k]    is the value of the k-th stored entry.
Within a column the entries are kept sorted by row index. The CSC format is needed by trust-constr in two places:
  1. The KKT projection block (projections.py:99) is materialised in CSC because scipy.sparse.linalg.factorized prefers it.
  2. A^T of a CSR Jacobian is naturally CSC of the same data.

      public CSCMatrix(int rows, int cols, int[] indptr, int[] indices, double[] data)
      Construct from raw CSC triplets. Inputs are defensively copied. See the class-level invariants for shape and ordering requirements.
      Parameters:
      rows - number of rows
      cols - number of columns
      indptr - column pointer array, length cols + 1
      indices - row index for each stored entry
      data - value for each stored entry
